root.label: Exception-Safety Guarantees
root.note: Contracts governing object invariants, resource cleanup, and container behavior when C++ code throws.

children.label: Abrahams Guarantee Levels
children.note: Four graduated promises defining what state survives an exception.

children.label: Nothrow and Nofail
children.note: Operations guaranteed never to emit exceptions, forming the bedrock for commit phases.

children.label: Strong Commit-Rollback
children.note: Failed calls leave program state identical to before the call began.

children.label: Basic No-Leak Invariants
children.note: Mandatory baseline guaranteeing zero leaked resources and destructible, valid objects.

children.label: Stack Unwinding Mechanics
children.note: How runtime cleanup executes between throw and catch.

children.label: Exception Object Storage
children.note: Throw initializes an implementation-managed exception object outside unwinding frames.

children.label: Partial Subobject Cleanup
children.note: Completed bases and members destroy in reverse order while the outer destructor is skipped.

children.label: std::terminate Triggers
children.note: Uncaught exceptions or throws escaping noexcept functions abort without guaranteed unwinding.

children.label: Strong Guarantee Patterns
children.note: Idioms that isolate failure-prone work from state mutation.

children.label: Copy-and-Swap Idiom
children.note: By-value parameter construction isolates allocations before a nothrow swap mutates this.

children.label: Prepare-Then-Commit Split
children.note: Stage new allocations locally first, then publish with noexcept swaps and pointer moves.

children.label: noexcept and Move Semantics
children.note: Compile-time checks linking exception specs to container efficiency.

children.label: std::move_if_noexcept
children.note: Containers copy instead of moving unless the move constructor is noexcept or non-copyable.

children.label: Conditional noexcept
children.note: Propagate member noexcept traits using noexcept(expr) on generic wrappers.

children.label: Implicitly noexcept Destructors
children.note: Every destructor defaults to noexcept(true) unless a subobject or specifier opts out.

children.label: Unwinding Edge Cases
children.note: Language rules around constructor handlers and nested exceptions.

children.label: Constructor Function-Try Blocks
children.note: Handlers around member initializers can translate errors but implicitly rethrow on exit.

children.label: std::uncaught_exceptions Depth
children.note: Counting active exceptions lets scope guards detect new unwinds inside outer catches.
